title: When the Postcard Burns
author: M. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Yara Nystrom, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
